stem.text: The two graphs represent the same wave.
Graph 1 shows the variation with time of the displacement at a particular distance. Graph 2 shows the variation with distance of the displacement at one instant.

stem.alt: Graph 1: displacement against time / s, with time labels 0, 0.5 and 1.0, showing a wave.
Graph 2: displacement against distance / cm, with distance labels 0, 30, 60 and 90, showing a wave.
